import pathlib
B = chr(96)
def lines(path):
    return pathlib.Path(path).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
agents_want = ('- Tests run in an isolated scratch tree; they never modify or depend on the live tree.', '- An adapter argv change requires a new provider contract version; the golden argv test enforces it.', 'Never write to the repository while a worker or brain run is in progress; never start a duplicate long-running check.')
guard_want = ('## Proof rules from 2A', 'Each rule says why it exists.', '- Test a refusal at the real entry point and assert the exact refused field path (for example ^doors.agy.deprecated^), because a refusal of some other field also exits non-zero.', '- Pair each negative test with one targeted mutation of the guard expression that makes that test fail, because a red test without it may be red for an unrelated reason.', '- Record each mutation proof as ^file:line:expression^, because a reviewer must be able to reapply the exact mutation.', '- An oracle fails on any compile or import error, because a check that cannot load the code under test has proved nothing.', '- When you add a broader rule, re-verify each narrower rule it overlaps with its own negative test, because the broader rule can refuse first and hide a narrower rule that stopped working.', '- State why each guard or check exists next to the rule, because a rule without a stated reason is the first one to be loosened.')
dispatch_want = ('- For a bug fix, reproduce the bug on the unfixed tree before dispatch, because a task whose oracle never failed on the base proves nothing.', '- Name the exact field for every value a task states (for example ^receipt.scope.result^, not the result), because a worker that has to guess the field guesses wrong.', '- A follow-up that would loosen a gate, guard or check goes to the planner as a proposal, never to a worker as a fix, because loosening a gate is a planning decision.')
init_want = ('Seat limits come from probes and are recorded in the registry; never rely on login checks inside a sandbox.',)
want = {'AGENTS.md': agents_want, '.agents/skills/guard-verification/SKILL.md': guard_want, '.agents/skills/dispatch-worker/SKILL.md': dispatch_want, '.agents/skills/mission-init/SKILL.md': init_want}
for path, expected in want.items():
    body = lines(path)
    for line in expected:
        line = line.replace('^', B)
        assert body.count(line) == 1, (path, line, body.count(line))
    if path != 'AGENTS.md':
        assert body[:2] == ['---', 'name: ' + path.split('/')[2]], (path, body[:2])
guard = lines('.agents/skills/guard-verification/SKILL.md')
assert guard.index(guard_want[0]) < guard.index('## Self-verification checklist')
dispatch = [line.replace(B, '^') for line in lines('.agents/skills/dispatch-worker/SKILL.md')]
assert dispatch.index('## 1. Establish preconditions') < dispatch.index(dispatch_want[0]) < dispatch.index(dispatch_want[1]) < dispatch.index('## 2. Dispatch the approved seat')
assert dispatch.index('## 5. Handle failures and gates') < dispatch.index(dispatch_want[2]) < dispatch.index('## Sandbox limits')
agents = lines('AGENTS.md')
assert agents.index('## Checks') < agents.index(agents_want[0]) < agents.index(agents_want[1]) < agents.index('## Mission rules') < agents.index(agents_want[2])
text = chr(10).join(agents)
assert '{{' not in text and 'orchestrator may accept a' in text and 'bash scripts/verify-mission.sh' in text
assert 'Workers never edit it. Only the orchestrator' in pathlib.Path('docs/templates/AGENTS.md.template').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
print('ok')
